verdict.rationale: Only community reports show that Box ships its own desktop sync client on macOS (box-comm-3, box-comm-4) and Windows (box-comm-6). The same users describe it as clunky, note CPU spikes on large folder trees and complain about a forced 'Default Sync Folder', so 'sync just works' is not established. The agent-runtime POSIX mount (box-docs-28) is a different capability and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the desktop clients, any evidence of selective sync, any evidence of on-demand/online-only files, and corroboration of reliable sync behavior.
